canonical_term: Affordable Housing Basis TIF Approval Condition
summary: For redevelopment projects using division of taxes in an area declared substandard and blighted because less than twenty percent of housing is affordable housing, approval requires residential housing construction and a finding that at least thirty percent of residential housing in the area will be affordable upon completion.
plain_language: If the blight/substandard basis is lack of affordable housing, the TIF project must itself move the area toward affordable housing.

object: project includes construction of residential housing
governing body finds at least 30 percent of residential housing in the area will be affordable housing when project is complete

relationships.note: Applies to projects using division of taxes under sec. 18-2147 when affordable-housing blight basis is used.

source_refs.citation: Nebraska DOR, 2025 Nebraska Legislative Changes, LB288 Community Development Law/Tax Increment Financing.
